title: Crestline's Own Price for the Same Tire — Out-of-Area Replacements
content:
For an out-of-area tire replacement reimbursed under Road Hazard Protection, Crestline's own price for the same tire is read from the covered set's original Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty ticket and the discounts it carried.

**Out-of-area own-price schedule.** Crestline's own price for the same tire is:
- the unit price less the tires invoice discount divided by the ticket's tire count (the whole tires-invoice discount, mounting and kits included, spread over the ticket's tires), rounded half up to the cent, when the covered set's ticket was charged to a Crestline Fleet Account and the fleet invoice posted for the vehicle on the set's purchase date with service category tires shows a program discount;
- the unit price less the line's set instant savings divided by the tire count, rounded half up to the cent, when the ticket was not charged to a fleet account and carried at least the line's set-instant-savings minimum number of tires of a line whose set instant savings is above zero;
- otherwise, the covered set's unit price.

| Ticket | Own price |
|---|---|
| charged to a fleet account, tires invoice on the purchase date shows a program discount | unit price less (discount divided by tire count), rounded to the cent |
| not charged to a fleet account, tire count at least the line's minimum, line savings above zero | unit price less (set instant savings divided by tire count), rounded to the cent |
| any other | unit price |

*Hypothetical figures.* Unit price 180.00 on a four-tire fleet ticket whose tires invoice shows an 88.00 program discount: 158.00. Unit price 119.99 on a four-tire cash ticket of a line with 40.00 set instant savings and a four-tire minimum: 109.99. The same cash ticket with three tires: 119.99.
